+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Capability model for dedicated-device speculator placement.
+
+A speculator can only move to a dedicated GPU outside the target TP group
+when all of its runtime state can be reconstructed from transported target
+features (target-conditioned, own-KV). Compatibility is decided from an
+explicit capability object reported by the standalone server for the actual
+adapter and checkpoint, never from the speculative method name alone.
+"""
+
+import enum
+from collections.abc import Collection
+from typing import Literal
+
+import msgspec
+
+StateDependency = Literal["own_kv", "target_kv", "target_owned_state"]
+StandaloneWeights = Literal["complete", "materializable", "missing"]
+
+# Method families eligible for remote placement. This is a coarse
+# config-time gate only: MTP variant names are normalized to "mtp" before
+# validation, so variant- and checkpoint-level compatibility is enforced by
+# the capability report in the HELLO handshake, not by this set.
+REMOTE_DRAFT_SUPPORTED_METHODS = frozenset({"eagle", "eagle3", "mtp"})
+
+
+class TargetFeatureKind(str, enum.Enum):
+    """Target-side features a speculator may require every round."""
+
+    TOKEN_IDS = "token_ids"
+    POSITIONS = "positions"
+    QUERY_LENS = "query_lens"
+    LAST_HIDDEN_STATES = "last_hidden_states"
+    AUX_HIDDEN_STATES = "aux_hidden_states"
+    NEXT_PREFILL_TOKENS = "next_prefill_tokens"
+    NUM_SAMPLED_TOKENS = "num_sampled_tokens"
+    NUM_REJECTED_TOKENS = "num_rejected_tokens"
+    TEMPERATURE = "temperature"
+    SEEDS = "seeds"
+    TARGET_TOPK_INDICES = "target_topk_indices"
+
+
+class SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """What a concrete speculator adapter and checkpoint support.
+
+    Reported by the standalone server during the HELLO handshake. The
+    verifier compares this against its own configuration and the features it
+    can provide, and rejects the connection with an explicit error instead
+    of silently running an unsupported combination.
+
+    Feature kinds are carried as plain strings (TargetFeatureKind values) so
+    that a newer-minor peer advertising an unknown kind stays decodable and
+    is rejected through `placement_incompatibilities` rather than failing
+    with a codec error.
+    """
+
+    state_dependency: StateDependency
+    required_features: tuple[str, ...]
+    num_prefill_lookahead: int = 0
+    """Lookahead tokens the adapter needs per prefill chunk; negotiation
+    input for the prefill-chunk contract, not a reject gate."""
+    supports_parallel_drafting: bool = False
+    supports_multi_module: bool = False
+    standalone_weights: StandaloneWeights = "missing"
+    supports_probabilistic_draft: bool = False
+
+
+def _feature_value(kind: str) -> str:
+    return kind.value if isinstance(kind, TargetFeatureKind) else kind
+
+
+def placement_incompatibilities(
+    capabilities: SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities,
+    *,
+    parallel_drafting: bool,
+    draft_sample_method: str,
+    provided_features: Collection[str],
+    uses_multi_module: bool = False,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Return reasons why a negotiated placement is unsupported.
+
+    An empty list means the verifier may use the remote speculator. Each
+    entry is a human-readable reason suitable for a startup error message.
+    ``provided_features`` accepts TargetFeatureKind members or their string
+    values.
+    """
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    if capabilities.state_dependency != "own_kv":
+        reasons.append(
+            "the speculator depends on target-owned state "
+            f"({capabilities.state_dependency!r}) that cannot be transported "
+            "to a dedicated device; only own-KV speculators are supported"
+        )
+    if capabilities.standalone_weights == "missing":
+        reasons.append(
+            "the draft checkpoint does not provide the weights required to "
+            "materialize the speculator in a standalone process (e.g. "
+            "embedding or LM head shared with the target)"
+        )
+    provided = {_feature_value(f) for f in provided_features}
+    missing = [
+        _feature_value(f)
+        for f in capabilities.required_features
+        if _feature_value(f) not in provided
+    ]
+    if missing:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"the verifier cannot provide required target features: {sorted(missing)}"
+        )
+    if parallel_drafting and not capabilities.supports_parallel_drafting:
+        reasons.append(
+            "parallel_drafting is enabled but the speculator checkpoint does "
+            "not support parallel drafting"
+        )
+    if uses_multi_module and not capabilities.supports_multi_module:
+        reasons.append(
+            "the draft checkpoint uses multiple speculative modules but the "
+            "speculator does not support multi-module drafting"
+        )
+    if (
+        draft_sample_method != "greedy"
+        and not capabilities.supports_probabilistic_draft
+    ):
+        reasons.append(
+            f"draft_sample_method={draft_sample_method!r} requires a draft "
+            "probability contract that the remote speculator does not "
+            "implement; only greedy draft sampling is supported"
+        )
+    return reasons
+
+
+def remote_draft_config_incompatibilities(
+    *,
+    method: str | None,
+    draft_tensor_parallel_size: int | None,
+    draft_sample_method: str,
+    uses_target_kv: bool | None,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Return reasons why a SpeculativeConfig cannot use remote_draft.
+
+    This is the config-time subset of the compatibility policy: everything
+    that can be decided before connecting to the standalone server. The
+    remaining checks (checkpoint capabilities, feature schema, fingerprints)
+    happen during the HELLO handshake via `placement_incompatibilities`.
+    ``uses_target_kv=None`` means the property could not be determined and
+    is rejected fail-closed.
+    """
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    if method not in REMOTE_DRAFT_SUPPORTED_METHODS:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"method {method!r} is not supported with remote_draft; "
+            f"supported methods: {sorted(REMOTE_DRAFT_SUPPORTED_METHODS)}"
+        )
+    if uses_target_kv is None:
+        reasons.append(
+            "cannot determine whether the draft model shares the target KV "
+            "cache (draft model config is not resolved)"
+        )
+    elif uses_target_kv:
+        reasons.append(
+            "the speculator shares the target KV cache directly and cannot "
+            "run on a dedicated device"
+        )
+    if draft_tensor_parallel_size is not None and draft_tensor_parallel_size > 1:
+        reasons.append(
+            "remote_draft requires draft_tensor_parallel_size=1; got "
+            f"{draft_tensor_parallel_size}"
+        )
+    # Blanket config-time restriction; relax together with the
+    # supports_probabilistic_draft gate in placement_incompatibilities.
+    if draft_sample_method != "greedy":
+        reasons.append(
+            "remote_draft currently requires draft_sample_method='greedy'; "
+            f"got {draft_sample_method!r}"
+        )
+    return reasons

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Allocation and CUDA failure classification for remote drafting."""
+
+import errno
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+
+import regex as re
+
+
+class CudaRuntimeError(RuntimeError):
+    """CUDA runtime failure retaining its numeric cudaError_t value."""
+
+    def __init__(self, message: str, *, cuda_error_code: int | None = None):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.cuda_error_code = cuda_error_code
+
+
+class CompletionUnknownError(RuntimeError):
+    """GPU work may still reference storage; retire the owning process."""
+
+
+def _exception_chain(error: BaseException) -> Iterator[BaseException]:
+    seen: set[int] = set()
+    pending = [error]
+    while pending:
+        error = pending.pop()
+        if id(error) in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(id(error))
+        yield error
+        if error.__cause__ is not None:
+            pending.append(error.__cause__)
+        if error.__context__ is not None:
+            pending.append(error.__context__)
+
+
+def cuda_context_fatal(error: BaseException) -> bool:
+    """Recognize CUDA errors documented to require a process restart."""
+    for cause in _exception_chain(error):
+        if isinstance(cause, CudaRuntimeError) and cause.cuda_error_code in (
+            226,  # cudaErrorContained
+            700,  # cudaErrorIllegalAddress
+            702,  # cudaErrorLaunchTimeout
+            710,  # cudaErrorAssert
+            714,  # cudaErrorHardwareStackError
+            715,  # cudaErrorIllegalInstruction
+            716,  # cudaErrorMisalignedAddress
+            717,  # cudaErrorInvalidAddressSpace
+            718,  # cudaErrorInvalidPc
+            719,  # cudaErrorLaunchFailure
+            810,  # cudaErrorMpsClientTerminated
+        ):
+            return True
+        message = str(cause).lower().replace("_", "")
+        if "cuda" in message and any(
+            detail in message
+            for detail in (
+                "illegal memory access",
+                "device-side assert triggered",
+                "unspecified launch failure",
+                "the launch timed out and was terminated",
+                "hardware stack error",
+                "illegal instruction",
+                "misaligned address",
+                "invalid address space",
+                "invalid program counter",
+                "tensor memory not completely freed",
+                "cudaerrorillegaladdress",
+                "cudaerrorassert",
+                "cudaerrorlaunchfailure",
+                "cudaerrorlaunchtimeout",
+                "cudaerrorhardwarestackerror",
+                "cudaerrorillegalinstruction",
+                "cudaerrormisalignedaddress",
+                "cudaerrorinvalidaddressspace",
+                "cudaerrorinvalidpc",
+                "cudaerrortensormemoryleak",
+                "cudaerrorcontained",
+                "cudaerrormpsclientterminated",
+                "contained error",
+                "mps client has been terminated",
+            )
+        ):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def runtime_unusable(error: BaseException) -> bool:
+    """Reject new work after context damage or uncertain GPU completion."""
+    return cuda_context_fatal(error) or any(
+        isinstance(item, CompletionUnknownError) for item in _exception_chain(error)
+    )
+
+
+def host_allocation_failure(error: BaseException) -> bool:
+    """Recognize direct host ENOMEM without masking unrelated runtime errors."""
+    if cuda_context_fatal(error):
+        return False
+    if isinstance(error, MemoryError):
+        return True
+    if isinstance(error, OSError):
+        return error.errno == errno.ENOMEM
+    return (
+        isinstance(error, RuntimeError)
+        and re.search(
+            r"DefaultCPUAllocator: can't allocate memory: you tried to allocate "
+            r"[0-9]+ bytes\. Error code 12(?:\s|$)",
+            str(error),
+        )
+        is not None
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Control-plane wire protocol for the standalone speculator server.
+
+The control plane carries small, low-frequency messages (handshake,
+sequence lifecycle, health, errors). High-frequency tensor traffic (target
+features, draft tokens) travels on a separate data plane and is referenced
+from these messages only by slot index.
+
+Versioning rules:
+- A different ``protocol_major`` rejects the connection.
+- ``protocol_minor`` bumps may only add optional fields; unknown fields are
+  ignored on decode.
+- The envelope is the single authority for the protocol version; payloads
+  never carry their own copy.
+"""
+
+import enum
+from typing import Annotated
+
+import msgspec
+
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.capabilities import (
+    SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities,
+)
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.transport import TransportError, check_data_frame_size
+
+# v2 requires peers to honor the per-round draft budget, including zero.
+# A v1 server would silently ignore it and still generate the maximum K.
+PROTOCOL_MAJOR = 2
+PROTOCOL_MINOR = 2
+
+# Field-level range constraints are enforced by msgspec on decode, so a
+# peer cannot deliver negative identifiers or degenerate shapes. Checks
+# that need negotiated session state (slot ranges, batch limits, schema
+# identity) belong to the session layer, not this module.
+NonNegativeInt = Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=0)]
+PositiveInt = Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(gt=0)]
+
+
+class ProtocolError(Exception):
+    """Malformed or incompatible control-plane message."""
+
+
+class ProtocolVersionError(ProtocolError):
+    """Peer speaks an incompatible protocol major version."""
+
+
+class SpeculatorStatusCode(enum.IntEnum):
+    """Per-batch / per-row status codes.
+
+    Failures are never encoded as token IDs; a failed row reports a status
+    here and ``valid_length=0`` so the verifier falls back to target-only
+    decoding for that request.
+    """
+
+    OK = 0
+    QUEUE_FULL = 1
+    TIMEOUT = 2
+    STALE_GENERATION = 3
+    ROUND_MISMATCH = 4
+    SEQUENCE_DESYNC = 5
+    UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE = 6
+    OUT_OF_MEMORY = 7
+    INTERNAL_ERROR = 8
+    PROTOCOL_ERROR = 9
+
+
+class SequenceKey(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """Identity of one draft sequence's state on the server.
+
+    ``generation`` increments whenever the verifier re-creates state for the
+    same request (e.g. after preemption and re-prefill); responses carrying
+    an older generation are discarded as stale.
+    """
+
+    verifier_instance_id: str
+    sequence_id: NonNegativeInt
+    generation: NonNegativeInt
+
+
+class FeatureSlot(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """One tensor slot in the negotiated target-feature layout.
+
+    ``kind`` is a TargetFeatureKind value carried as a plain string so that
+    unknown kinds from a newer-minor peer stay decodable.
+    """
+
+    kind: str
+    dtype: str
+    trailing_shape: tuple[PositiveInt, ...]
+    optional: bool = False
+    per_sequence: bool = False
+    """One row per sequence (e.g. temperature) instead of one row per
+    target token (e.g. hidden states)."""
+
+
+class TargetFeatureSchema(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """Fixed slot ordering negotiated at handshake.
+
+    After the handshake the data plane only ever refers to this layout by
+    ``schema_id``; per-round messages never carry string feature maps.
+    """
+
+    schema_id: NonNegativeInt
+    slots: tuple[FeatureSlot, ...]
+
+
+class RemoteServerLimits(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """Hard limits the server enforces.
+
+    Both peers reject the session at handshake when these cannot hold the
+    verifier's declared scheduler limits (see Hello).
+    """
+
+    max_batch_size: PositiveInt
+    max_feature_tokens: PositiveInt
+    max_sequences: PositiveInt
+    max_model_len: PositiveInt
+    ring_slots: NonNegativeInt = 0
+
+
+class Hello(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Verifier -> server handshake request."""
+
+    verifier_instance_id: str
+    target_fingerprint: str
+    tokenizer_fingerprint: str
+    method: str
+    num_speculative_tokens: PositiveInt
+    parallel_drafting: bool
+    supported_transports: tuple[str, ...]
+    draft_checkpoint_fingerprint: str = ""
+    max_num_seqs: NonNegativeInt = 0
+    """Largest batch the verifier may send; 0 means undeclared."""
+    max_num_batched_tokens: NonNegativeInt = 0
+    """Largest feature token count per message; 0 means undeclared."""
+    max_model_len: NonNegativeInt = 0
+    """Longest sequence the verifier may grow; 0 means undeclared."""
+
+
+class HelloAck(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Server -> verifier handshake response."""
+
+    server_id: str
+    session_id: str
+    session_epoch: NonNegativeInt
+    selected_transport: str
+    capabilities: SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities
+    feature_schema: TargetFeatureSchema
+    limits: RemoteServerLimits
+    server_vllm_version: str = ""
+
+
+class OpenSequence(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Register a new SequenceKey and reserve draft state for it."""
+
+    key: SequenceKey
+
+
+class PrefillChunk(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Append one prompt chunk to a sequence's draft state.
+
+    Token-level feature slots hold ``num_tokens`` rows and per-sequence
+    slots hold one row.
+
+    ``offset`` must equal the number of tokens the server has already
+    applied; a gap or checksum mismatch yields SEQUENCE_DESYNC. Duplicate
+    chunks with a matching checksum may be ACKed idempotently.
+    """
+
+    key: SequenceKey
+    offset: NonNegativeInt
+    num_tokens: NonNegativeInt
+    is_final: bool
+    feature_slot: NonNegativeInt
+    checksum: NonNegativeInt
+    execution_timeout_ms: NonNegativeInt | None = None
+    """Remaining relative execution budget when the control frame is sent."""
+    execution_group_id: NonNegativeInt | None = None
+    """Prefill pipeline identity; all chunks share its first server deadline."""
+
+
+class AdvanceAndPropose(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Apply the last verification outcome and propose the next K tokens.
+
+    Per-sequence feature slots hold one row per key. Token-level slots hold
+    ``sum(query_lens)`` rows, the target tokens of each key in key order;
+    without ``query_lens_slot`` every key contributes exactly one row.
+    """
+
+    batch_id: NonNegativeInt
+    keys: tuple[SequenceKey, ...]
+    accepted_counts_slot: NonNegativeInt
+    recovery_tokens_slot: NonNegativeInt
+    feature_slot: NonNegativeInt
+    round_ids_slot: NonNegativeInt | None = None
+    query_lens_slot: NonNegativeInt | None = None
+    """Integer frame [len(keys)] of token-level feature rows per key."""
+    num_speculative_tokens: NonNegativeInt | None = None
+    """This round's draft budget; None uses the maximum negotiated by Hello.
+
+    Zero still applies verified context but produces no usable drafts. Results
+    retain the negotiated maximum width, with valid lengths bounded by this K.
+    """
+    execution_timeout_ms: NonNegativeInt | None = None
+    """Optional relative budget; older minor peers retain their server limit."""
+
+
+class ProposalResponse(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Server -> verifier completion notice for one proposal batch.
+
+    Draft tokens, per-row valid lengths, and per-row status live in the
+    data-plane slot referenced by ``result_slot``; a failed batch carries
+    no result slot.
+    """
+
+    batch_id: NonNegativeInt
+    sequence_number: NonNegativeInt
+    result_slot: NonNegativeInt | None = None
+    status: SpeculatorStatusCode = SpeculatorStatusCode.OK
+
+
+class SequenceAck(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Server -> verifier acknowledgement of a sequence command."""
+
+    key: SequenceKey
+    status: SpeculatorStatusCode = SpeculatorStatusCode.OK
+    detail: str = ""
+
+
+class CloseSequence(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Release draft KV and state; duplicate closes are idempotent."""
+
+    keys: tuple[SequenceKey, ...]
+
+
+class CancelBatch(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Cancel not-yet-started work after a timeout or request finish."""
+
+    batch_id: NonNegativeInt
+
+
+class Ping(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Liveness probe; either side may send it."""
+
+    nonce: int = 0
+
+
+class Pong(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Liveness / load report."""
+
+    nonce: int = 0
+    queue_depth: NonNegativeInt = 0
+    active_sequences: NonNegativeInt = 0
+    healthy: bool = True
+
+
+class ErrorReply(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Session-level error not tied to a specific sequence."""
+
+    status: SpeculatorStatusCode
+    detail: str = ""
+
+
+class MessageEnvelope(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Outer frame of every control-plane message.
+
+    ``request_id`` correlates an RPC with its reply; model state identity is
+    carried by SequenceKey inside the payload, never by request_id.
+    """
+
+    protocol_major: PositiveInt
+    protocol_minor: NonNegativeInt
+    message_type: str
+    session_id: str
+    request_id: NonNegativeInt
+    payload: bytes
+
+
+_MESSAGE_TYPES: dict[str, type[msgspec.Struct]] = {
+    "hello": Hello,
+    "hello_ack": HelloAck,
+    "open_sequence": OpenSequence,
+    "prefill_chunk": PrefillChunk,
+    "advance_and_propose": AdvanceAndPropose,
+    "proposal_response": ProposalResponse,
+    "sequence_ack": SequenceAck,
+    "close_sequence": CloseSequence,
+    "cancel_batch": CancelBatch,
+    "ping": Ping,
+    "pong": Pong,
+    "error": ErrorReply,
+}
+_TYPE_NAMES = {cls: name for name, cls in _MESSAGE_TYPES.items()}
+
+# Codec instances reuse internal buffers and are not thread-safe; use them
+# from a single thread per connection.
+_encoder = msgspec.msgpack.Encoder()
+_envelope_decoder = msgspec.msgpack.Decoder(MessageEnvelope)
+_payload_decoders = {
+    name: msgspec.msgpack.Decoder(cls) for name, cls in _MESSAGE_TYPES.items()
+}
+
+
+def encode_message(
+    message: msgspec.Struct,
+    *,
+    session_id: str = "",
+    request_id: int = 0,
+) -> bytes:
+    """Wrap a payload struct in a MessageEnvelope and encode it."""
+    type_name = _TYPE_NAMES.get(type(message))
+    if type_name is None:
+        raise ProtocolError(f"unregistered message type: {type(message).__name__}")
+    envelope = MessageEnvelope(
+        protocol_major=PROTOCOL_MAJOR,
+        protocol_minor=PROTOCOL_MINOR,
+        message_type=type_name,
+        session_id=session_id,
+        request_id=request_id,
+        payload=_encoder.encode(message),
+    )
+    return _encoder.encode(envelope)
+
+
+def decode_envelope(data: bytes) -> MessageEnvelope:
+    """Decode and version-check the outer envelope."""
+    try:
+        envelope = _envelope_decoder.decode(data)
+    except msgspec.DecodeError as e:
+        raise ProtocolError(f"malformed envelope: {e}") from e
+    if envelope.protocol_major != PROTOCOL_MAJOR:
+        raise ProtocolVersionError(
+            f"unsupported protocol major {envelope.protocol_major}, "
+            f"expected {PROTOCOL_MAJOR}"
+        )
+    return envelope
+
+
+def limit_shortfalls(hello: Hello, limits: RemoteServerLimits) -> list[str]:
+    """Reasons ``limits`` cannot serve the scheduler limits in ``hello``.
+
+    Undeclared (zero) verifier limits are not checked.
+    """
+    reasons = []
+    for server_name, offered, verifier_name, needed in (
+        ("max_batch_size", limits.max_batch_size, "max_num_seqs", hello.max_num_seqs),
+        (
+            "max_feature_tokens",
+            limits.max_feature_tokens,
+            "max_num_batched_tokens",
+            hello.max_num_batched_tokens,
+        ),
+        ("max_model_len", limits.max_model_len, "max_model_len", hello.max_model_len),
+    ):
+        if offered < needed:
+            reasons.append(
+                f"server {server_name}={offered} cannot hold the verifier's "
+                f"{verifier_name}={needed}"
+            )
+    return reasons
+
+
+def inline_feature_frame_rejections(
+    hello: Hello, schema: TargetFeatureSchema, limits: RemoteServerLimits
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Check each inline slot against its declared maximum encoded byte size."""
+    max_tokens = hello.max_num_batched_tokens or limits.max_feature_tokens
+    max_sequences = hello.max_num_seqs or limits.max_batch_size
+    reasons = []
+    for index, slot in enumerate(schema.slots):
+        rows = max_sequences if slot.per_sequence else max_tokens
+        try:
+            # Slot IDs grow throughout a session; reserve their full wire width.
+            check_data_frame_size(
+                (1 << 64) - 1, slot.dtype, (rows, *slot.trailing_shape)
+            )
+        except TransportError as e:
+            reasons.append(f"inline feature slot {index} ({slot.kind}): {e}")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def inline_receive_budgets(
+    hello: Hello, schema: TargetFeatureSchema, limits: RemoteServerLimits
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Maximum encoded data frame and bytes preceding one control message."""
+    rows = hello.max_num_seqs or limits.max_batch_size
+    tokens = hello.max_num_batched_tokens or limits.max_feature_tokens
+    # Accepted counts, recovery tokens, query lengths and round IDs can each
+    # use int64. Reserve full-width slot IDs without allocating payloads.
+    slot_id = (1 << 64) - 1
+    sizes = [check_data_frame_size(slot_id, "int64", (rows,))] * 4
+    sizes.extend(
+        check_data_frame_size(
+            slot_id,
+            slot.dtype,
+            (rows if slot.per_sequence else tokens, *slot.trailing_shape),
+        )
+        for slot in schema.slots
+    )
+    return max(sizes), sum(sizes)
+
+
+def decode_payload(envelope: MessageEnvelope) -> msgspec.Struct:
+    """Decode the payload struct named by the envelope's message_type."""
+    decoder = _payload_decoders.get(envelope.message_type)
+    if decoder is None:
+        raise ProtocolError(f"unknown message type: {envelope.message_type!r}")
+    try:
+        return decoder.decode(envelope.payload)
+    except msgspec.DecodeError as e:
+        raise ProtocolError(f"malformed {envelope.message_type} payload: {e}") from e

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Server adapter for target-conditioned own-KV speculators.
+
+Protocol commands become draft steps the way a co-located model runner
+would schedule them:
+
+- A prompt chunk that is not the last runs at once. Its final position is
+  completed by the next prompt token, carried as NEXT_PREFILL_TOKENS.
+- The last prompt chunk waits for the sequence's first round, because its
+  final position needs the token the target samples from it. That round
+  carries no target tokens for the sequence and supplies the sampled token
+  as its recovery token.
+- A later round covers the target tokens verified in the previous step:
+  the accepted drafts and the recovery token were sampled, the remaining
+  drafts were rejected.
+
+The device work (block tables, attention metadata, the draft forward) is
+delegated to a DraftStepExecutor.
+"""
+
+import itertools
+import time
+from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
+from collections.abc import Collection, Sequence
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.capabilities import (
+    SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities,
+    TargetFeatureKind,
+)
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.protocol import (
+    SequenceKey,
+    SpeculatorStatusCode,
+    TargetFeatureSchema,
+)
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.runtime.step import (
+    DraftStepPlan,
+    DraftStepPlanner,
+    DraftStepRow,
+)
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.server import (
+    AdapterError,
+    PrefillInputs,
+    StandaloneDraftAdapter,
+    StandaloneProposalBatch,
+    StandaloneProposalResult,
+)
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.session import frame_to_tensor, tensor_to_frame
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.transport import DataFrame, frame_to_ints
+
+Features = list[torch.Tensor | None]
+
+
+class DraftStepExecutor(ABC):
+    """Runs planned draft steps on the drafter's device."""
+
+    def warmup(self) -> None:  # noqa: B027
+        """Complete device initialization before the server accepts requests."""
+
+    @property
+    def max_num_tokens(self) -> int | None:
+        """Maximum tokens per execution, or None for an unbounded executor."""
+        return None
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def execute(
+        self,
+        plan: DraftStepPlan,
+        features: Features,
+        *,
+        num_speculative_tokens: int | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Run one draft step and return ``[plan.num_reqs, K]`` draft tokens.
+
+        ``features`` follow the negotiated schema: token-level tensors hold
+        ``plan.num_tokens`` rows in plan order, per-sequence tensors hold
+        ``plan.num_reqs`` rows, and omitted optional slots are None. The
+        executor applies ``plan.block_table_updates`` to its block tables
+        before running the step.
+
+        ``num_speculative_tokens`` limits draft generation without skipping
+        context updates; None uses the configured maximum. Return width stays
+        at that maximum even when the effective budget is zero.
+        """
+
+
+class TargetConditionedDraftAdapter(StandaloneDraftAdapter):
+    """Feeds protocol rows through a DraftStepPlanner into an executor."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        executor: DraftStepExecutor,
+        planner: DraftStepPlanner,
+        *,
+        capabilities: SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities,
+        feature_schema: TargetFeatureSchema,
+        methods: Collection[str],
+        draft_checkpoint_fingerprint: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        self._lookahead_slot = _lookahead_slot(
+            feature_schema, planner.num_prefill_lookahead
+        )
+        if capabilities.num_prefill_lookahead != planner.num_prefill_lookahead:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"capabilities declare {capabilities.num_prefill_lookahead} "
+                f"prefill lookahead tokens, the planner uses "
+                f"{planner.num_prefill_lookahead}"
+            )
+        self.executor = executor
+        self.planner = planner
+        self._capabilities = capabilities
+        self._schema = feature_schema
+        self._methods = frozenset(methods)
+        self._fingerprint = draft_checkpoint_fingerprint
+        self._last_chunks: dict[SequenceKey, tuple[int, Features]] = {}
+        """Final prompt chunks waiting for the token sampled from them."""
+
+    def capabilities(self) -> SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities:
+        return self._capabilities
+
+    def warmup(self) -> None:
+        self.executor.warmup()
+
+    def feature_schema(self) -> TargetFeatureSchema:
+        return self._schema
+
+    def supported_methods(self) -> Collection[str]:
+        return self._methods
+
+    def draft_checkpoint_fingerprint(self) -> str:
+        return self._fingerprint
+
+    def open_sequence(self, key: SequenceKey) -> None:
+        if not self.planner.open(key):
+            raise AdapterError(
+                SpeculatorStatusCode.QUEUE_FULL,
+                f"all {self.planner.max_num_reqs} draft request slots are in use",
+            )
+
+    def prefill(self, key: SequenceKey, inputs: PrefillInputs) -> None:
+        if inputs.num_tokens <= 0:
+            raise AdapterError(
+                SpeculatorStatusCode.PROTOCOL_ERROR,
+                "a prompt chunk must contain at least one token",
+            )
+        features = _tensors(inputs.features)
+        if inputs.is_final:
+            self._last_chunks[key] = (inputs.num_tokens, features)
+            return
+        lookahead = features[self._lookahead_slot]
+        if lookahead is None:
+            raise AdapterError(
+                SpeculatorStatusCode.PROTOCOL_ERROR,
+                "a prompt chunk that is not the last must carry next_prefill_tokens",
+            )
+        row = DraftStepRow(
+            key,
+            num_tokens=inputs.num_tokens,
+            num_sampled=0,
+            next_prefill_tokens=tuple(int(t) for t in lookahead[0].tolist()),
+        )
+        plan, failures = self.planner.plan([row], num_speculative_tokens=0)
+        if failures:
+            raise AdapterError(*failures[0])
+        # A prompt chunk only fills draft KV; its drafts are never used.
+        self.executor.execute(plan, features, num_speculative_tokens=0)
+        self.planner.commit(plan)
+
+    def advance_and_propose(
+        self, batch: StandaloneProposalBatch
+    ) -> StandaloneProposalResult:
+        num_rows = len(batch.keys)
+        effective_k = batch.effective_num_speculative_tokens
+        if effective_k is None:
+            effective_k = batch.num_speculative_tokens
+        if not 0 <= effective_k <= batch.num_speculative_tokens:
+            raise ValueError("round draft budget exceeds the negotiated maximum")
+        accepted = frame_to_ints(batch.accepted_counts)
+        recovery = frame_to_ints(batch.recovery_tokens)
+        features = _tensors(batch.features)
+        starts = list(itertools.accumulate(batch.query_lens, initial=0))
+        statuses = [SpeculatorStatusCode.OK] * num_rows
+        rows: list[DraftStepRow] = []
+        batch_rows: list[int] = []
+        sources: list[Features] = []
+        for i in batch.active_rows:
+            key = batch.keys[i]
+            query_len = batch.query_lens[i]
+            last_chunk = self._last_chunks.get(key)
+            if last_chunk is not None:
+                # The round only delivers the token sampled from the prompt.
+                if query_len or accepted[i]:
+                    statuses[i] = SpeculatorStatusCode.SEQUENCE_DESYNC
+                    continue
+                num_tokens, source = last_chunk
+                row = DraftStepRow(
+                    key, num_tokens, num_sampled=1, last_sampled=recovery[i]
+                )
+            else:
+                if not 0 <= accepted[i] < query_len:
+                    statuses[i] = SpeculatorStatusCode.SEQUENCE_DESYNC
+                    continue
+                source = [
+                    None
+                    if tensor is None or spec.per_sequence
+                    else tensor[starts[i] : starts[i] + query_len]
+                    for spec, tensor in zip(self._schema.slots, features)
+                ]
+                row = DraftStepRow(
+                    key,
+                    query_len,
+                    num_sampled=accepted[i] + 1,
+                    num_rejected=query_len - 1 - accepted[i],
+                    last_sampled=recovery[i],
+                )
+            rows.append(row)
+            batch_rows.append(i)
+            sources.append(source)
+
+        max_num_tokens = self.executor.max_num_tokens
+        groups: list[list[int]] = [[]]
+        num_tokens = 0
+        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
+            if max_num_tokens is not None:
+                if row.num_tokens > max_num_tokens:
+                    statuses[batch_rows[i]] = SpeculatorStatusCode.OUT_OF_MEMORY
+                    continue
+                if num_tokens + row.num_tokens > max_num_tokens:
+                    groups.append([])
+                    num_tokens = 0
+            groups[-1].append(i)
+            num_tokens += row.num_tokens
+        token_ids = torch.zeros(
+            num_rows, batch.num_speculative_tokens, dtype=torch.int64
+        )
+        for group in groups:
+            if (
+                batch.execution_deadline is not None
+                and time.monotonic() >= batch.execution_deadline
+            ):
+                for index in group:
+                    statuses[batch_rows[index]] = SpeculatorStatusCode.TIMEOUT
+                continue
+            plan, failures = self.planner.plan(
+                [rows[i] for i in group], num_speculative_tokens=effective_k
+            )
+            for index, (status, _) in failures.items():
+                statuses[batch_rows[group[index]]] = status
+            planned = [
+                (batch_rows[i], sources[i])
+                for index, i in enumerate(group)
+                if index not in failures
+            ]
+            if not planned:
+                continue
+            step_features = self._step_features(features, planned)
+            if (
+                batch.execution_deadline is not None
+                and time.monotonic() >= batch.execution_deadline
+            ):
+                for index, _ in planned:
+                    statuses[index] = SpeculatorStatusCode.TIMEOUT
+                continue
+            drafts = self.executor.execute(
+                plan,
+                step_features,
+                num_speculative_tokens=effective_k,
+            )
+            self.planner.commit(plan)
+            row_index = torch.tensor([i for i, _ in planned], dtype=torch.long)
+            token_ids[row_index, :effective_k] = drafts[:, :effective_k].to(
+                "cpu", torch.int64
+            )
+            for row in plan.rows:
+                self._last_chunks.pop(row.key, None)
+        valid_lengths = torch.tensor(
+            [
+                effective_k if status is SpeculatorStatusCode.OK else 0
+                for status in statuses
+            ],
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+        )
+        return StandaloneProposalResult(
+            token_ids=tensor_to_frame(0, token_ids),
+            valid_lengths=tensor_to_frame(0, valid_lengths),
+            row_statuses=tuple(statuses),
+        )
+
+    def close_sequences(self, keys: tuple[SequenceKey, ...]) -> None:
+        for key in keys:
+            self._last_chunks.pop(key, None)
+            self.planner.close(key)
+
+    def _step_features(
+        self, round_features: Features, planned: Sequence[tuple[int, Features]]
+    ) -> Features:
+        """Assemble the step's features in plan order.
+
+        Token-level rows come from each row's source (a buffered prompt
+        chunk or its segment of the round); per-sequence rows always come
+        from the round. An optional token-level slot is passed on only when
+        every row has it.
+        """
+        step: Features = []
+        for j, spec in enumerate(self._schema.slots):
+            if spec.per_sequence:
+                tensor = round_features[j]
+                step.append(
+                    None
+                    if tensor is None
+                    else tensor[torch.tensor([i for i, _ in planned])]
+                )
+                continue
+            segments = [source[j] for _, source in planned]
+            if any(segment is None for segment in segments):
+                step.append(None)
+            else:
+                step.append(torch.cat(segments))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+        return step
+
+
+def _tensors(frames: Sequence[DataFrame | None]) -> Features:
+    return [None if frame is None else frame_to_tensor(frame) for frame in frames]
+
+
+def _lookahead_slot(schema: TargetFeatureSchema, num_lookahead: int) -> int:
+    for i, spec in enumerate(schema.slots):
+        if spec.kind == TargetFeatureKind.NEXT_PREFILL_TOKENS.value:
+            if (
+                not spec.per_sequence
+                or not spec.optional
+                or tuple(spec.trailing_shape) != (num_lookahead,)
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "next_prefill_tokens must be an optional per-sequence slot "
+                    f"of {num_lookahead} tokens; got {spec}"
+                )
+            return i
+    raise ValueError("the feature schema needs a next_prefill_tokens slot")

+) -> tuple[TargetConditionedDraftAdapter, RuntimeContract]:

+        model=args.target_model,

+        dtype=args.dtype,
+        tensor_parallel_size=1,
+        max_model_len=args.max_model_len,
+        max_num_seqs=args.max_batch_size,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=args.max_feature_tokens,
+        enforce_eager=True,
+        async_scheduling=False,
+        enable_prefix_caching=False,
+        enable_chunked_prefill=True,
+        attention_config=attention,
+        moe_backend=args.moe_backend,
+        block_size=args.block_size,
+        speculative_config={
+            "model": args.draft_model,
+            "revision": args.draft_revision,
+            "method": args.method,
+            "num_speculative_tokens": args.num_speculative_tokens,
+            "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1,
+            "attention_backend": args.attention_backend,
+        },
+    ).create_engine_config()
+    contract = create_runtime_contract(config)
+    adapter = make_gpu_adapter(
+        config,
+        device=torch.device(args.device),
+        kv_cache_bytes=int(args.draft_kv_cache_gib * 1024**3),
+        shared_weights_source=args.shared_weights_source,
+    )
+    return adapter, contract

+    """Bind distributed groups to the same visible GPU as the draft model."""
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform

+        get_assigned_physical_gpu_ids,
+        set_assigned_physical_gpu_ids,

+        raise ValueError(
+            f"standalone drafter device {device} is not a visible CUDA GPU"
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Draft-only KV block pool.
+
+The standalone process owns its draft KV cache outright: blocks are handed
+out per request slot and returned when the sequence closes. Running out of
+blocks fails the request that needed them; resident sequences are never
+evicted to make room.
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+
+NULL_BLOCK_ID = 0
+"""Reserved block that padded tokens write to; never handed out."""
+
+
+class DraftKVExhausted(Exception):
+    """The pool cannot grow a sequence to the requested length."""
+
+
+class DraftBlockPool:
+    """Fixed pool of KV blocks keyed by request slot."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_blocks: int, block_size: int) -> None:
+        if num_blocks < 2:
+            raise ValueError("a draft KV pool needs the null block plus one")
+        if block_size <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"block_size must be positive, got {block_size}")
+        self.num_blocks = num_blocks
+        self.block_size = block_size
+        # Only the prefix is free. Keep storage allocated so cleanup never
+        # needs to grow a list while recovering from an allocation failure.
+        self._free = list(range(num_blocks - 1, NULL_BLOCK_ID, -1))
+        self._num_free = len(self._free)
+        self._owned: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
+
+    @property
+    def num_free_blocks(self) -> int:
+        return self._num_free
+
+    def blocks(self, req_index: int) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        return tuple(self._owned.get(req_index, ()))
+
+    def ensure(self, req_index: int, num_positions: int) -> list[int]:
+        """Grow ``req_index`` to cover positions ``[0, num_positions)``.
+
+        Returns the block ids appended, in order. Allocation is all or
+        nothing: on DraftKVExhausted the slot keeps its previous blocks.
+        """
+        owned = self._owned.get(req_index, [])
+        missing = cdiv(num_positions, self.block_size) - len(owned)
+        if missing <= 0:
+            return []
+        if missing > self._num_free:
+            raise DraftKVExhausted(
+                f"need {missing} more draft KV blocks, {self._num_free} free"
+            )
+        # Prepare allocation-backed metadata before consuming free capacity.
+        remaining = self._num_free - missing
+        new_blocks = self._free[remaining : self._num_free][::-1]
+        self._owned[req_index] = owned + new_blocks
+        self._num_free = remaining
+        return new_blocks
+
+    def release(self, req_index: int) -> None:
+        owned = self._owned.get(req_index)
+        if owned is None:
+            return
+        returned = self._num_free + len(owned)
+        for index, block_id in enumerate(reversed(owned), self._num_free):
+            self._free[index] = block_id
+        # Until all writes succeed these cells are outside the free prefix.
+        del self._owned[req_index]
+        self._num_free = returned
+
+    def slot_mapping(self, req_index: int, positions: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+        """KV slot of each position; positions must be covered by ``ensure``."""
+        blocks = np.asarray(self._owned[req_index], dtype=np.int64)
+        return blocks[positions // self.block_size] * self.block_size + (
+            positions % self.block_size
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Single-group own-KV layouts for the standalone draft planner.
+
+Sliding-window attention keeps a full-context block table here. The attention
+backend applies its window; the planner does not evict or recycle old positions.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    AttentionSpec,
+    FullAttentionSpec,
+    KVCacheConfig,
+    KVCacheGroupSpec,
+    KVCacheSpec,
+    KVCacheTensor,
+    KVQuantMode,
+    MLAAttentionSpec,
+    SlidingWindowSpec,
+    SparseCacheRole,
+    compute_layout_strides,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_layout import KVCacheLayout
+
+
+def select_standalone_kv_spec(specs: Mapping[str, KVCacheSpec]) -> AttentionSpec:
+    """Validate the homogeneous dense cache consumed by the own-KV planner."""
+    if not specs:
+        raise ValueError("standalone drafter has no attention KV layers")
+    first = next(iter(specs.values()))
+    # Subclasses include sparse/compressed caches and target-owned state with
+    # different position or allocation contracts; accepting their base is unsafe.
+    if type(first) not in (FullAttentionSpec, MLAAttentionSpec, SlidingWindowSpec):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "standalone runtime requires full-attention, dense MLA, or "
+            "sliding-window KV; " + type(first).__name__ + " is unsupported"
+        )
+    if any(type(spec) is not type(first) or spec != first for spec in specs.values()):
+        raise ValueError("standalone runtime requires one uniform KV group")
+    assert isinstance(first, AttentionSpec)
+    if (
+        first.tokens_per_state != 1
+        or first.num_head_slots is not None
+        or first.state_content_bytes is not None
+        or first.kv_quant_mode != KVQuantMode.NONE
+        or first.dtype not in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16, torch.float32)
+        or first.page_size_padded is not None
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("standalone runtime requires dense unquantized KV pages")
+    if isinstance(first, FullAttentionSpec) and (
+        first.non_causal or first.attention_chunk_size is not None
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("standalone runtime requires causal token-addressed KV")
+    if isinstance(first, MLAAttentionSpec) and (
+        first.num_kv_heads != 1
+        or first.head_size_v != 0
+        or first.model_version is not None
+        or first.is_index_group_leader
+        or first.cache_role != SparseCacheRole.SPARSE
+        or first.non_causal_multi_token_decode
+        or first.sliding_window is not None
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("standalone runtime supports dense MLA without an indexer")
+    return first
+
+
+def make_standalone_kv_config(
+    spec: AttentionSpec,
+    layer_names: list[str],
+    kv_cache_bytes: int,
+    layout: KVCacheLayout,
+) -> KVCacheConfig:
+    """Describe disjoint layer ranges for the shared KV allocator."""
+    if not layer_names or len(set(layer_names)) != len(layer_names):
+        raise ValueError("standalone KV layer names must be nonempty and unique")
+    select_standalone_kv_spec(dict.fromkeys(layer_names, spec))
+    if not layout.is_layer_compact:
+        raise ValueError("standalone runtime requires layer-compact KV layout")
+    page_bytes = spec.page_size_bytes
+    num_blocks = kv_cache_bytes // (len(layer_names) * page_bytes)
+    if num_blocks < 2:
+        raise ValueError("draft KV budget cannot hold null block plus one block")
+    layer_stride, block_stride, *_ = compute_layout_strides(
+        spec, num_blocks, len(layer_names), layout
+    )
+    if block_stride % spec.get_block_stride_alignment():
+        raise ValueError("standalone KV layout does not satisfy block alignment")
+    # All layers share one allocation, but must own distinct byte ranges.
+    return KVCacheConfig(
+        num_blocks=num_blocks,
+        kv_cache_tensors=[
+            KVCacheTensor(
+                size=page_bytes * num_blocks * len(layer_names),
+                layers=list(layer_names),
+                layer_stride=layer_stride,
+                block_stride=block_stride,
+            )
+        ],
+        kv_cache_groups=[
+            KVCacheGroupSpec(list(layer_names), spec, is_eagle_group=True)
+        ],
+        kv_cache_layout=layout.name,
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Checkpoint-derived contract shared by the verifier and standalone runtime."""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import regex as re
+from huggingface_hub import ResolvedRevision
+
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.capabilities import (
+    SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities,
+    TargetFeatureKind,
+)
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.protocol import FeatureSlot, TargetFeatureSchema
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RuntimeContract:
+    schema: TargetFeatureSchema
+    capabilities: SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities
+    target_fingerprint: str
+    tokenizer_fingerprint: str
+    draft_fingerprint: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _MTPModelContract:
+    target_architectures: tuple[str, ...]
+    max_speculative_tokens: int | None = None
+
+
+# These native implementations consume one target hidden vector and own their
+# attention KV. Other MTP architectures need a separate state/feature contract.
+_MTP_MODELS = {
+    "MiMoMTPModel": _MTPModelContract(("MiMoForCausalLM",), 1),
+    "ErnieMTPModel": _MTPModelContract(("Ernie4_5_MoeForCausalLM",), 1),
+    "Qwen3NextMTP": _MTPModelContract(("Qwen3NextForCausalLM",)),
+    "Glm4MoeMTPModel": _MTPModelContract(("Glm4MoeForCausalLM",)),
+    "Glm4MoeLiteMTPModel": _MTPModelContract(("Glm4MoeLiteForCausalLM",)),
+    "ExaoneMoeMTP": _MTPModelContract(("ExaoneMoeForCausalLM", "ExaoneMoEForCausalLM")),
+    "NemotronHMTPModel": _MTPModelContract(
+        ("NemotronHForCausalLM", "NemotronHPuzzleForCausalLM")
+    ),
+    "HYV3MTPModel": _MTPModelContract(("HYV3ForCausalLM",)),
+}
+
+
+def _validate_mtp_contract(target: Any, spec: Any) -> None:
+    draft = spec.draft_model_config
+    config = draft.hf_config
+    architectures = getattr(config, "architectures", None) or []
+    if len(architectures) != 1 or architectures[0] not in _MTP_MODELS:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported standalone MTP architecture: {architectures}")
+    architecture = architectures[0]
+    contract = _MTP_MODELS[architecture]
+    target_architectures = getattr(target.hf_config, "architectures", None) or []
+    if (
+        len(target_architectures) != 1
+        or target_architectures[0] not in contract.target_architectures
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"{architecture} requires its matching target architecture")
+    if (
+        target.get_hidden_size() != draft.get_hidden_size()
+        or target.get_vocab_size() != draft.get_vocab_size()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("standalone MTP requires matching target hidden/vocab sizes")
+    if target.max_model_len > draft.max_model_len:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "standalone MTP requires draft max_model_len "
+            f"({draft.max_model_len}) to cover target max_model_len "
+            f"({target.max_model_len}); reduce the target context limit"
+        )
+    if getattr(config, "num_nextn_predict_layers", None) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("standalone MTP requires exactly one checkpoint MTP module")
+    if (
+        contract.max_speculative_tokens is not None
+        and spec.num_speculative_tokens > contract.max_speculative_tokens
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"{architecture} supports exactly one speculative token")
+    for model in (target, draft):
+        hf_config = model.hf_config
+        rope = (
+            getattr(hf_config, "rope_parameters", None)
+            or getattr(hf_config, "rope_scaling", None)
+            or {}
+        )
+        if (
+            getattr(model, "is_multimodal_model", False)
+            or getattr(model, "uses_mrope", False)
+            or getattr(hf_config, "text_config", None) is not None
+            or "mrope_section" in rope
+            or getattr(hf_config, "hc_mult", 1) != 1
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "standalone MTP requires scalar positions and text features"
+            )
+    if architecture == "NemotronHMTPModel":
+        pattern = getattr(config, "mtp_hybrid_override_pattern", "")
+        if not pattern or "*" not in pattern or set(pattern) - {"*", "E"}:
+            raise ValueError("standalone Nemotron MTP requires attention/MoE layers")
+    if architecture == "Glm4MoeLiteMTPModel" and hasattr(config, "index_topk"):
+        raise ValueError("standalone GLM MLA does not support a sparse indexer")
+
+
+def _fingerprint(value: Any) -> str:
+    encoded = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=str)
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def checkpoint_revision(source: str, revision: str | None) -> str | None:
+    """Identify loaded weights independently of their configuration repository."""
+    if Path(source).exists():
+        return None
+    if isinstance(revision, ResolvedRevision):
+        if revision._repo_id not in (None, source) or revision._repo_type != "model":
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"checkpoint revision was resolved for a different repository: {source}"
+            )
+        revision = revision.resolved
+    if not isinstance(revision, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", revision):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "remote drafting requires an immutable checkpoint revision "
+            f"or local checkpoint artifacts: {source}"
+        )
+    return revision
+
+
+def _model_identity(model: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    weights_source = getattr(model, "model_weights", "")
+    if weights_source and weights_source != model.model:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "remote drafting does not support a separate model_weights source; "
+            "the advertised checkpoint must be the loaded weight source"
+        )
+    config = model.hf_config.to_dict()
+    for field in ("_name_or_path", "transformers_version", "_commit_hash"):
+        config.pop(field, None)
+    path = Path(model.model)
+    identity: dict[str, Any]
+    if path.is_dir():
+        filenames = sorted(
+            str(file.relative_to(path))
+            for pattern in (
+                "*.safetensors",
+                "*.bin",
+                "*.pt",
+                "*.gguf",
+                "*.safetensors.index.json",
+                "*.bin.index.json",
+            )
+            for file in path.rglob(pattern)
+        )
+        identity = {"artifacts": _local_artifact_digests(path, filenames)}
+    elif path.exists():
+        identity = {"artifact": _local_artifact_digests(path.parent, [path.name])}
+    else:
+        identity = {
+            "repository": model.model,
+            "revision": checkpoint_revision(model.model, model.revision),
+        }
+    return {
+        "checkpoint": identity,
+        "config": config,
+        "dtype": str(model.dtype),
+        "quantization": model.quantization,
+    }
+
+
+def _local_artifact_digests(path: Path, filenames: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Hash deployed bytes at startup; mutable paths are never a cache key."""
+    if not filenames:
+        raise ValueError(f"no verifiable checkpoint/tokenizer artifacts in {path}")
+    digests = {}
+    for name in filenames:
+        file = path / name
+        before = file.stat()
+        digest = hashlib.sha256()
+        with file.open("rb") as handle:
+            while chunk := handle.read(1 << 20):
+                digest.update(chunk)
+        after = file.stat()
+        if any(
+            getattr(before, field) != getattr(after, field)
+            for field in ("st_dev", "st_ino", "st_size", "st_mtime_ns", "st_ctime_ns")
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"checkpoint artifact changed while fingerprinting: {file}"
+            )
+        digests[name] = digest.hexdigest()
+    return digests
+
+
+def _tokenizer_identity(target: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path = Path(target.tokenizer)
+    if path.is_dir():
+        filenames = [
+            name
+            for name in (
+                "tokenizer.json",
+                "tokenizer_config.json",
+                "special_tokens_map.json",
+                "added_tokens.json",
+                "vocab.json",
+                "vocab.txt",
+                "merges.txt",
+                "tokenizer.model",
+            )
+            if (path / name).is_file()
+        ]
+        return {"artifacts": _local_artifact_digests(path, filenames)}
+    return {
+        "tokenizer": target.tokenizer,
+        "revision": checkpoint_revision(target.tokenizer, target.tokenizer_revision),
+    }
+
+
+def create_runtime_contract(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> RuntimeContract:
+    """Resolve the supported feature layout without loading any model weights."""
+    spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    if spec is None or spec.draft_model_config is None:
+        raise ValueError("standalone drafting requires a resolved speculative config")
+    target = vllm_config.model_config
+    draft = spec.draft_model_config
+    target_type = target.hf_config.model_type
+    if spec.method == "eagle3":
+        if target_type not in ("gpt_oss", "qwen3"):
+            raise ValueError("standalone EAGLE3 currently supports GPT-OSS and Qwen3")
+    elif spec.method == "mtp":
+        _validate_mtp_contract(target, spec)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported standalone method: {spec.method}")
+    if spec.parallel_drafting or spec.draft_sample_method != "greedy":
+        raise ValueError("standalone runtime requires sequential greedy drafting")
+
+    hidden_size = target.get_hidden_size()
+    dtype = str(target.dtype).removeprefix("torch.")
+    eagle = getattr(draft.hf_config, "eagle_config", None) or {}
+    use_aux = spec.method == "eagle3" and eagle.get("use_aux_hidden_state", True)
+    slots = [
+        FeatureSlot(TargetFeatureKind.TOKEN_IDS.value, "int32", ()),
+        FeatureSlot(TargetFeatureKind.POSITIONS.value, "int64", ()),
+    ]
+    if use_aux:
+        from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.eagle3_utils import (
+            get_eagle3_aux_layers_from_config,
+        )
+
+        layer_ids = get_eagle3_aux_layers_from_config(spec)
+        # Both supported target families capture three layers by default.
+        count = len(layer_ids) if layer_ids else 3
+        projection_count = getattr(draft.hf_config, "num_aux_layers", None)
+        if projection_count is None:
+            projection_count = getattr(draft.hf_config, "num_aux_hidden_states", None)
+        if projection_count is not None and projection_count != count:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "EAGLE3 auxiliary projection count does not match selected "
+                f"target layers: {projection_count} != {count}"
+            )
+        slots.append(
+            FeatureSlot(
+                TargetFeatureKind.AUX_HIDDEN_STATES.value, dtype, (hidden_size * count,)
+            )
+        )
+    else:
+        slots.append(
+            FeatureSlot(
+                TargetFeatureKind.LAST_HIDDEN_STATES.value, dtype, (hidden_size,)
+            )
+        )
+    slots.append(
+        FeatureSlot(
+            TargetFeatureKind.NEXT_PREFILL_TOKENS.value,
+            "int64",
+            (1,),
+            optional=True,
+            per_sequence=True,
+        )
+    )
+    schema = TargetFeatureSchema(schema_id=1, slots=tuple(slots))
+    layout = [(s.kind, s.dtype, s.trailing_shape) for s in slots]
+    target_identity = _model_identity(target)
+    return RuntimeContract(
+        schema=schema,
+        capabilities=SpeculatorPlacementCapabilities(
+            state_dependency="own_kv",
+            required_features=tuple(s.kind for s in slots if not s.optional),
+            num_prefill_lookahead=1,
+            standalone_weights="materializable",
+        ),
+        target_fingerprint=_fingerprint({"target": target_identity, "layout": layout}),
+        tokenizer_fingerprint=_fingerprint(
+            {
+                "identity": _tokenizer_identity(target),
+                "mode": target.tokenizer_mode,
+                "vocab_size": target.get_vocab_size(),
+                "special_tokens": {
+                    k: target_identity["config"].get(k)
+                    for k in ("bos_token_id", "eos_token_id", "pad_token_id")
+                },
+            }
+        ),
+        draft_fingerprint=_fingerprint(
+            {
+                "draft": _model_identity(draft),
+                "layout": layout,
+                "method": spec.method,
+                "num_speculative_tokens": spec.num_speculative_tokens,
+            }
+        ),
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Per-step draft scheduling for the standalone runtime.
+
+In co-located mode the target model runner hands a speculator its own step:
+target positions and sequence lengths, the shared block tables, and how many
+tokens were sampled and rejected per request. The standalone runtime has no
+target runner, so the planner rebuilds exactly those fields for the draft's
+own KV cache from what the protocol carries. A request's draft state mirrors
+the target's computed tokens: rows rewrite KV for every position they cover,
+including positions the target then rejects, and only the accepted prefix is
+committed.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.protocol import SequenceKey, SpeculatorStatusCode
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.remote.runtime.kv import DraftBlockPool, DraftKVExhausted
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DraftStepRow:
+    """One sequence's share of a draft step.
+
+    ``num_tokens`` target tokens starting at the sequence's committed length
+    are covered; the last ``num_rejected`` of them were rejected by the
+    target. ``num_sampled == 0`` marks a prompt chunk that is not the last:
+    its final position is completed by ``next_prefill_tokens`` instead of a
+    sampled token.
+    """
+
+    key: SequenceKey
+    num_tokens: int
+    num_sampled: int
+    num_rejected: int = 0
+    last_sampled: int = 0
+    next_prefill_tokens: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class BlockTableUpdate:
+    """New blocks for one request slot's block table.
+
+    ``start`` is the table index of the first new block; 0 means the slot
+    belongs to a new sequence and its previous table must be discarded.
+    """
+
+    start: int
+    block_ids: list[int]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DraftStepPlan:
+    """Batch-ordered step inputs for the rows the planner admitted."""
+
+    rows: tuple[DraftStepRow, ...]
+    req_indices: np.ndarray
+    """[num_reqs] request slot of each row (the runner's idx_mapping)."""
+    num_scheduled_tokens: np.ndarray
+    """[num_reqs] target tokens per row."""
+    query_start_loc: np.ndarray
+    """[num_reqs + 1] prefix sums of num_scheduled_tokens."""
+    num_computed_tokens: np.ndarray
+    """[num_reqs] committed positions before this step."""
+    seq_lens: np.ndarray
+    """[num_reqs] committed positions plus this step's tokens."""
+    positions: np.ndarray
+    """[num_tokens] target position of every token."""
+    slot_mapping: np.ndarray
+    """[num_tokens] draft KV slot of every token."""
+    block_table_updates: dict[int, BlockTableUpdate]
+    """Block table changes per request slot, to apply before the step."""
+    num_sampled: np.ndarray
+    num_rejected: np.ndarray
+    last_sampled: np.ndarray
+    next_prefill_tokens: np.ndarray
+    """[num_reqs, num_prefill_lookahead]"""
+
+    @property
+    def num_reqs(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.rows)
+
+    @property
+    def num_tokens(self) -> int:
+        return int(self.query_start_loc[-1])
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _DraftSequence:
+    req_index: int
+    num_computed: int = 0
+
+
+class DraftStepPlanner:
+    """Request slots, draft KV blocks, and committed lengths per sequence.
+
+    ``max_num_reqs`` bounds open sequences, matching the per-request buffers
+    a speculator allocates. Each sequence keeps KV blocks for its committed
+    length, the next query, and the positions used by additional draft forwards.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        block_pool: DraftBlockPool,
+        *,
+        max_num_reqs: int,
+        max_model_len: int,
+        num_speculative_tokens: int,
+        num_prefill_lookahead: int = 1,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.block_pool = block_pool
+        self.max_num_reqs = max_num_reqs
+        self.max_model_len = max_model_len
+        self.num_speculative_tokens = num_speculative_tokens
+        self.num_prefill_lookahead = num_prefill_lookahead
+        self._free_slots = list(range(max_num_reqs - 1, -1, -1))
+        self._num_free_slots = max_num_reqs
+        self._sequences: dict[SequenceKey, _DraftSequence] = {}
+
+    def __contains__(self, key: SequenceKey) -> bool:
+        return key in self._sequences
+
+    @property
+    def num_open(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._sequences)
+
+    def req_index(self, key: SequenceKey) -> int:
+        return self._sequences[key].req_index
+
+    def num_computed(self, key: SequenceKey) -> int:
+        return self._sequences[key].num_computed
+
+    def open(self, key: SequenceKey) -> bool:
+        """Assign a request slot; False when every slot is in use."""
+        if key in self._sequences:
+            raise ValueError(f"sequence {key} is already open")
+        if not self._num_free_slots:
+            return False
+        remaining = self._num_free_slots - 1
+        self._sequences[key] = _DraftSequence(self._free_slots[remaining])
+        self._num_free_slots = remaining
+        return True
+
+    def close(self, key: SequenceKey) -> None:
+        sequence = self._sequences.get(key)
+        if sequence is not None:
+            returned = self._num_free_slots + 1
+            self._free_slots[self._num_free_slots] = sequence.req_index
+            self.block_pool.release(sequence.req_index)
+            del self._sequences[key]
+            self._num_free_slots = returned
+
+    def plan(
+        self,
+        rows: Sequence[DraftStepRow],
+        *,
+        num_speculative_tokens: int | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[DraftStepPlan, dict[int, tuple[SpeculatorStatusCode, str]]]:
+        """Admit rows into one step and reserve their KV.
+
+        Returns the plan for the admitted rows and the failure of every row
+        that was left out, keyed by its index in ``rows``. Malformed rows
+        raise ValueError: they indicate a bug in the caller, not a
+        per-sequence condition.
+        """
+        if num_speculative_tokens is None:
+            num_speculative_tokens = self.num_speculative_tokens
+        if not 0 <= num_speculative_tokens <= self.num_speculative_tokens:
+            raise ValueError("round draft budget exceeds the configured maximum")
+        if len({row.key for row in rows}) != len(rows):
+            raise ValueError("a draft step cannot cover a sequence twice")
+        admitted: list[DraftStepRow] = []
+        updates: dict[int, BlockTableUpdate] = {}
+        failures: dict[int, tuple[SpeculatorStatusCode, str]] = {}
+        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
+            self._validate(row)
+            sequence = self._sequences.get(row.key)
+            if sequence is None:
+                failures[i] = (SpeculatorStatusCode.SEQUENCE_DESYNC, "not open")
+                continue
+            seq_len = sequence.num_computed + row.num_tokens
+            if seq_len > self.max_model_len:
+                failures[i] = (
+                    SpeculatorStatusCode.OUT_OF_MEMORY,
+                    f"sequence would reach {seq_len} positions, beyond "
+                    f"max_model_len={self.max_model_len}",
+                )
+                continue
+            start = len(self.block_pool.blocks(sequence.req_index))
+            draft_extent = min(
+                self.max_model_len,
+                seq_len - row.num_rejected + max(num_speculative_tokens - 1, 0),
+            )
+            try:
+                blocks = self.block_pool.ensure(
+                    sequence.req_index, max(seq_len, draft_extent)
+                )
+            except DraftKVExhausted as e:
+                failures[i] = (SpeculatorStatusCode.OUT_OF_MEMORY, str(e))
+                continue
+            if blocks:
+                updates[sequence.req_index] = BlockTableUpdate(start, blocks)
+            admitted.append(row)
+        return self._build(admitted, updates), failures
+
+    def commit(self, plan: DraftStepPlan) -> None:
+        """Advance every planned row by its accepted tokens."""
+        for row in plan.rows:
+            self._sequences[row.key].num_computed += row.num_tokens - row.num_rejected
+
+    def _validate(self, row: DraftStepRow) -> None:
+        if row.num_tokens <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"row for {row.key} covers no tokens")
+        if not 0 <= row.num_rejected < row.num_tokens:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"row for {row.key} rejects {row.num_rejected} of "
+                f"{row.num_tokens} tokens"
+            )
+        if row.num_sampled < 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"row for {row.key} samples {row.num_sampled} tokens")
+        if row.num_sampled == 0:
+            if row.num_rejected:
+                raise ValueError(f"prompt chunk for {row.key} rejects tokens")
+            if len(row.next_prefill_tokens) != self.num_prefill_lookahead:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"prompt chunk for {row.key} carries "
+                    f"{len(row.next_prefill_tokens)} lookahead tokens, expected "
+                    f"{self.num_prefill_lookahead}"
+                )
+
+    def _build(
+        self, rows: list[DraftStepRow], updates: dict[int, BlockTableUpdate]
+    ) -> DraftStepPlan:
+        req_indices = np.array(
+            [self._sequences[row.key].req_index for row in rows], dtype=np.int32
+        )
+        num_computed = np.array(
+            [self._sequences[row.key].num_computed for row in rows], dtype=np.int32
+        )
+        num_scheduled = np.array([row.num_tokens for row in rows], dtype=np.int32)
+        query_start_loc = np.zeros(len(rows) + 1, dtype=np.int32)
+        np.cumsum(num_scheduled, out=query_start_loc[1:])
+        positions = np.concatenate(
+            [
+                np.arange(start, start + count, dtype=np.int64)
+                for start, count in zip(num_computed, num_scheduled)
+            ]
+            or [np.empty(0, dtype=np.int64)]
+        )
+        slot_mapping = np.concatenate(
+            [
+                self.block_pool.slot_mapping(
+                    int(req_index),
+                    positions[query_start_loc[i] : query_start_loc[i + 1]],
+                )
+                for i, req_index in enumerate(req_indices)
+            ]
+            or [np.empty(0, dtype=np.int64)]
+        )
+        lookahead = np.zeros((len(rows), self.num_prefill_lookahead), dtype=np.int64)
+        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
+            if row.num_sampled == 0:
+                lookahead[i] = row.next_prefill_tokens
+        return DraftStepPlan(
+            rows=tuple(rows),
+            req_indices=req_indices,
+            num_scheduled_tokens=num_scheduled,
+            query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+            num_computed_tokens=num_computed,
+            seq_lens=num_computed + num_scheduled,
+            positions=positions,
+            slot_mapping=slot_mapping,
+            block_table_updates=updates,
+            num_sampled=np.array([row.num_sampled for row in rows], dtype=np.int32),
+            num_rejected=np.array([row.num_rejected for row in rows], dtype=np.int32),
+            last_sampled=np.array([row.last_sampled for row in rows], dtype=np.int64),
+            next_prefill_tokens=lookahead,
+        )

+"""Materialize target embedding/head without loading its transformer layers."""
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+from huggingface_hub.errors import EntryNotFoundError
+from safetensors import safe_open
+
+from vllm.transformers_utils.repo_utils import hf_api

+
+def selected_checkpoint_weights(
+    source: str, revision: str | None, names: tuple[str, ...]
+) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Fetch only the safetensor shards containing the requested named tensors.
+
+    Missing tensors are omitted so tied embeddings can be resolved explicitly.
+    Network/authentication errors propagate; they never trigger a full download.
+    Indexless local checkpoints use the native loader's safetensors file glob.
+    """
+    local = Path(source).is_dir()
+
+    def resolve(filename: str) -> Path:
+        if local:
+            return Path(source) / filename
+        return Path(hf_api().hf_hub_download(source, filename, revision=revision))
+
+    result: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    try:
+        index = resolve("model.safetensors.index.json")
+        with index.open() as handle:
+            weight_map = json.load(handle)["weight_map"]
+    except (FileNotFoundError, EntryNotFoundError):
+        files = (
+            sorted(Path(source).glob("*.safetensors"))
+            if local
+            else [resolve("model.safetensors")]
+        )
+        if not files:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(
+                f"no safetensors checkpoint files in {source}"
+            ) from None
+        for file in files:
+            with safe_open(file, framework="pt", device="cpu") as handle:
+                available = set(handle.keys())
+                for name in names:
+                    if name in available:
+                        if name in result:
+                            raise ValueError(
+                                f"duplicate selected checkpoint tensor: {name}"
+                            ) from None
+                        result[name] = handle.get_tensor(name)
+        return result
+
+    selected = {name: weight_map[name] for name in names if name in weight_map}
+    for filename in sorted(set(selected.values())):
+        with safe_open(resolve(filename), framework="pt", device="cpu") as handle:
+            for name, shard in selected.items():
+                if shard == filename:
+                    result[name] = handle.get_tensor(name)
+    return result
+
+
+def materialize_target_shell(
+    model_config: "ModelConfig",
+    device: torch.device,
+    *,
+    shared_weights_source: str = "auto",
+) -> torch.nn.Module:
+    """Create only the modules the existing local draft loader shares."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+        ParallelLMHead,
+        VocabParallelEmbedding,
+    )
+
+    source = (
+        model_config.model if shared_weights_source == "auto" else shared_weights_source
+    )
+    target_revision = checkpoint_revision(model_config.model, model_config.revision)
+    if source != model_config.model and not Path(source).is_dir():
+        raise ValueError(
+            "alternate shared weights must be a local directory verified against "
+            "the target checkpoint; unpinned alternate repositories are unsupported"
+        )
+    revision = target_revision if source == model_config.model else None
+    embedding_names: tuple[str, ...] = ("model.embed_tokens.weight",)
+    if getattr(model_config.hf_config, "model_type", None) in (
+        "nemotron_h",
+        "nemotron_h_puzzle",
+    ):
+        # Match the independent prefix and embedding-name mappings in the
+        # native loader, including partially converted checkpoints.
+        embedding_names = (
+            "backbone.embeddings.weight",
+            "backbone.embed_tokens.weight",
+            "model.embeddings.weight",
+            *embedding_names,
+        )
+    tied = getattr(model_config.hf_config, "tie_word_embeddings", False)
+    names = embedding_names if tied else (*embedding_names, "lm_head.weight")
+    tensors = selected_checkpoint_weights(source, revision, names)
+    if source != model_config.model:
+        expected = selected_checkpoint_weights(
+            model_config.model, target_revision, names
+        )
+        if tensors.keys() != expected.keys() or any(
+            tensor.dtype != expected[name].dtype
+            or tensor.shape != expected[name].shape
+            or not torch.equal(tensor, expected[name])
+            for name, tensor in tensors.items()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "alternate shared weights differ from the target checkpoint"
+            )
+    present_embeddings = [name for name in embedding_names if name in tensors]
+    if len(present_embeddings) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{source} requires exactly one embedding weight from {embedding_names}; "
+            f"found {present_embeddings}"
+        )
+    embed = tensors[present_embeddings[0]]
+    head = embed if tied else tensors.get("lm_head.weight")
+    if head is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{source} has no lm_head.weight and is not tied")
+    shape = (model_config.get_vocab_size(), model_config.get_hidden_size())
+    for name, tensor in (("embedding", embed), ("LM head", head)):
+        if tuple(tensor.shape) != shape or tensor.dtype not in (
+            torch.float16,
+            torch.bfloat16,
+            torch.float32,
+            torch.float64,
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"standalone {name} requires an unquantized {shape} weight; "
+                f"got {tuple(tensor.shape)} {tensor.dtype}"
+            )
+    shell = torch.nn.Module()
+    shell.model = torch.nn.Module()
+    with device:
+        shell.model.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            *shape, params_dtype=model_config.dtype, quant_config=None
+        )
+    # The unquantized, bias-free head needs no second materialized allocation.
+    with torch.device("meta") if tied else device:
+        shell.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+            *shape, params_dtype=model_config.dtype, quant_config=None
+        )
+    if tied:
+        shell.lm_head = shell.lm_head.tie_weights(shell.model.embed_tokens)
+    shell.model.embed_tokens.weight_loader(shell.model.embed_tokens.weight, embed)
+    if not tied:
+        shell.lm_head.weight_loader(shell.lm_head.weight, head)
+    return shell
+
+
+def model_weight_bytes(model: torch.nn.Module) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """Count draft, embedding, and head weights, assigning ties to embedding."""
+    remaining = {id(p): p for p in model.parameters()}
+
+    def take(module: torch.nn.Module | None) -> int:
+        size = 0
+        if module is not None:
+            for parameter in module.parameters():
+                if remaining.pop(id(parameter), None) is not None:
+                    size += parameter.numel() * parameter.element_size()
+        return size
+
+    embedding = take(getattr(model.model, "embed_tokens", None))
+    head = take(getattr(model, "lm_head", None))
+    draft = sum(p.numel() * p.element_size() for p in remaining.values())
+    return draft, embedding, head
